$comment: Data audit budgets (TEST-005), one entry per data tag, checked by scripts/data-audit.ts. Counts are exact for a pinned tag: a parser change that moves one updates this file in the same PR. Problem counts are ceilings and spellsWithDice is a floor. A DATA_TAG bump needs a new entry: run `bun run data:audit -- --tag <tag> --write-budget`, then review the diff. branchAllow entries are human verdicts that a multi-name additionalSpells block is a real choice even though the entity's own prose does not say so. prose, once a tag has saved Jev judgments (scripts/data-judgments.json, written by `bun run data:judge`), caps the prose-scan disagreements no prose.allow entry settles; each allow entry is a human verdict that the scanner's reading stands.
